name: progress
label: Where we are: the video's steps with the current one lit, so a viewer always knows the way

variant.label: rail = a line of steps across the top, corner = a small counter and the step name, list = a stacked list at the side

steps.label: The steps, | separated (2 to 6, 1 or 2 words each)

current.label: The step we are on now (1 = first)

move_at.label: When it moves from the step before to the current one

out.label: edge = leave by its edge at out_at, cut = hold to the end

out_at.label: edge: when it leaves (blank = 0.4 s before the end)
